title: Multi3Hate: Multimodal, Multilingual, and Multicultural Hate Speech Detection with Vision–Language Models
findings: Among the five sociopolitical categories studied, the 'Religion' category showed the highest cross-cultural label agreement among human annotators, with an average of 78%.
